text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help her get used to real races, she 
was training in her Racing Gear today. As 
I took another good look at her...
choice_data_list:
Hmm...? Somehow, this feels strangely 
nostalgic...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if you've known it since long ago...? 
Even though this outfit is something I 
made after enrolling in the academy...
choice_data_list: ん……？なんだか妙に懐かしい……
choice_data_list_en: Hm...? Why does this feel so nostalgic...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it feels nostalgic. After all, 
this thing pinned to my chest is..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ... Could it be you don't remember...?
choice_data_list: Huh! Um...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racking my brain, I stare intently at her. 
“This thing pinned to my chest”...?
choice_data_list: えっ！えーと……？
choice_data_list_en: Wait! Uhm...?

text_block_list.text:
Waah! Buena-san, are you in your racing 
silks today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "So cute~! It looks wicked good on ya~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Special Week as she called out 
to me, I felt on the verge of remembering 
something.
choice_data_list:
Right, I think she had something to do 
with it...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's right. Even Spe-san wore this...
choice_data_list: そうだ、彼女が関係していたような……
choice_data_list_en: Right, I think she had something to do with it...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see...! So that's what was going 
on.
choice_data_list:
I'm pretty sure you had something to do 
with it, though.

I'm pretty sure you had something to do 
with it, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, "myself"...?
choice_data_list: たしか、君が関係してた気がするんだけど
たしか、貴方が関係してた気がするんだけど
choice_data_list_en: I'm pretty sure you were involved in that...
I believe you were involved in that, though...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!! Could that be the clover brooch!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, it finally clicked. That's 
right... a long time ago, that brooch was 
something I gave to Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Look, look...! I bought a cute pen case. 
This pink and purple... hehehe.
choice_data_list: It looks like Special Week.
It looks like Special Week, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right? Ehehe, and you know what else? I 
bought the official Spe-san T-shirt 
too...!
choice_data_list: スペシャルウィークみたいだ
スペシャルウィークみたいだね
choice_data_list_en: Just like Special Week.
Just like Special Week, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this clover shape...! It looks just 
like the one on Spe-san's racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Buena Vista pointed at a gold 
brooch displayed in the accessories shop.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"So cute...! It's wonderful. It's smaller 
than Spe-san's, but it looks really easy 
to use, which is great!"
choice_data_list: Sounds good, it'll definitely suit you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, I wonder how much it is...
choice_data_list: いいね、絶対似合うよ！
choice_data_list_en: Sounds great, it'll definitely look good on you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
This looks a bit out of reach for my 
allowance. Ehehe... let's go!
choice_data_list: (Buena... That's it!)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! Don't think I've seen you 
delivering the paper before. Impressive 
for someone so young. Keep up the good 
work~.
choice_data_list: （ブエナ…………そうだっ！）
choice_data_list_en: (Buena...... That's it!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was only short-term, waking 
up early every morning and riding my bike 
around before school was tough. But 
thinking of Buena Vista made it no 
hardship at all.
choice_data_list: はいっ！……えっほ、えっほ！
choice_data_list_en: Right! ...Heave-ho, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And clutching the money I'd saved, I 
bought the brooch they'd held for me, then 
nervously ran off to meet her...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—So, what did you want to talk about? Why 
are you being so formal all of a sudden?”
choice_data_list: This is... a present!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...! Is this... from back then...!?
choice_data_list: これ……プレゼント！
choice_data_list_en: This is... a present!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did you suddenly start that 
part-time job because, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I confessed with a slight blush. But it 
really was no big deal. I just wanted to 
make Buena Vista happy...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. To be honest, I really, 
really wanted this...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because they're my inspiration. Even if 
it's just in appearance, getting closer 
makes me happy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was intended only as a modest gift, but 
at that moment, it reaffirmed something to 
me: her dream was my dream too.
choice_data_list:
Let's reach it someday—that breathtaking 
view!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah...! Let's make it come true, 
together...!
choice_data_list: いつか辿り着こう。あの絶景に！
choice_data_list_en: Someday, we'll reach it. That breathtaking view!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I remember it completely now! That said, 
though it felt expensive back then, it's 
not high enough quality to attach to a 
racing outfit...
choice_data_list:
Are you sure? Shouldn't it be something 
more impressive...?

Are you sure? Shouldn't it be something 
more impressive...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because to me, it's a one-of-a-kind 
treasure. It just has to be this one."
choice_data_list: いいのか？もっと立派なものじゃなくて……
いいの？もっと立派なものじゃなくて……
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure? It doesn't need to be something fancier...?
Are you sure? It doesn't need to be something fancier...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: ブエナ……！
choice_data_list_en: Buena...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, Spe-san! Um, this was bought by 
my Trainer with money from a part-time job 
back when they were a student...
choice_data_list:
Oh right, Buena wanted it— she looks up to 
you, after all

Oh right, Buena wanted it— she looks up to 
you, after all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We accidentally left Special Week behind. 
The two of them began explaining all at 
once...
choice_data_list: そうそう、君に憧れたブエナが欲しがって
そうそう、貴方に憧れたブエナが欲しがって
choice_data_list_en: Oh right, Buena looked up to you and wanted it.
Oh right, Buena looked up to you and wanted it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We accidentally left Special Week behind. 
The two of them began explaining all at 
once...
choice_data_list: ブエナ、あの時も感動してたよな
ブエナ、あの時も感動してたよね
スペシャルウィークのモチーフは特別なんだ
choice_data_list_en: Buena, you were really moved back then too, weren't you?
Buena, you were really moved back then too, weren't you?
Special Week's motif is special.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And hearing that made me get all 
teary-eyed.
choice_data_list: ブエナ、あの時も感動してたよな
ブエナ、あの時も感動してたよね
スペシャルウィークのモチーフは特別なんだ
choice_data_list_en: Buena, you were really moved back then too, weren't you?
Buena, you were really moved back then too, weren't you?
Special Week's motif is special.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! They were so happy they were moved 
to tears, huh.
choice_data_list: そうだったね
choice_data_list_en: Right, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Whenever I remember that 
time... even now... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah! Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you're that moved by it... it makes me 
feel touched too...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because my dream all started 
with Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm the beginning... really?! To have 
someone as amazing as you think of me that 
way, Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Does that mean I was able to show 
them a dream? As the number one Umamusume 
in Japan...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Spe-san is Japan's number one... No, 
to us, she is the world's best Umamusume.
